Fixture Title (Mirror Layout)

Abstract

This mirror-style fixture verifies the heading-based fallback path in the IJCAI fetcher: when a page exposes an explicit <h2>Abstract</h2> heading, the fetcher must concatenate only the following-sibling nodes until the next heading, so BibTeX and References sections stay strictly out of the abstract.

A second paragraph is included so that ordinary multi-paragraph abstracts are exercised too, and to comfortably clear the MIN_ABSTRACT_CHARS length gate defined in base.py.

BibTeX

@inproceedings{fixture2026,
  title  = {A Fixture Paper},
  author = {Alice and Bob},
  year   = {2026},
}
